answer_summary: One idealized COF-2 honeycomb side contains 8 arene C-C increments, 2 C-B increments, and 2 B-O increments, so a = 17.00 angstrom and d = 17*sqrt(3) angstrom = 29.4448637... angstrom, reported as 29.4 angstrom to three significant figures.
assumptions: The printed bond lengths C-C/C=C = 1.39 angstrom, C-B = 1.56 angstrom, and B-O = 1.38 angstrom are exact stipulated constants.
As instructed by the problem, linker width is neglected when tracing the idealized centre-to-centre honeycomb side.
The COF-2 drawing yields a side walk with 8 arene C-C, 2 C-B, and 2 B-O length increments.
The final display uses TASK.json's answer-blind default of three significant figures because the printed question and blank answer sheet specify no precision.
